All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`). I only changed source files, and there were two bugs.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`.** The check `i <= leftover` gave one extra cent to one payer too many. For example, `splitBill(900, 3)` returned `[301, 300, 300]`, so the total was also wrong. It is now `i < leftover`. This fixed the "even split", "leftover cents" and "total is preserved" tests.

2. **`src/duration.js`, no validation of the whole string in `parseDuration`.** The regex scan ignored anything that didn't match, so `"10m and change"` was accepted as 600 seconds. I added a check that the entire input is one or more `<digits><h|m|s>` groups, and it throws `SyntaxError` otherwise. I left the existing zero-match check in place. It can no longer trigger, but removing it wasn't needed for the fix.

I did the work myself without delegating, since it was small.
